comment: The release manifest's vectors (release.json: version, the cyfr, cyfr_locus, caddy and tailscale image digests, the scaffold tarball's digest and the schema fingerprint of the release's Arca, 64 lower-case hex digits). valid and valid_prerelease are manifests every reader accepts, a release's and a pre-release's, and each refused manifest one every reader refuses: apps/codex/internal/release/manifest_test.go holds ParseManifest to them, and tests/ci-release-graph.py holds the release workflow's manifest check to them. versions is the one rule for a release version, as a tag names it: every accepted one is a version and every refused one is not, to apps/codex/internal/release (IsVersion), Cyfr.ReleaseChannel (version?/1, apps/cyfr/test/cyfr/release_channel_test.exs), tests/ci-release-graph.py's SEMVER, the release workflow's version step, scripts/scaffold-tarball.sh and scripts/release.sh alike; ascending lists versions in increasing SemVer precedence, which release.Compare and Cyfr.ReleaseChannel's newer?/2 hold. signature is a test Sigstore instance's trusted root, the valid manifest's exact bytes with a v0.3 bundle signed under the release workflow's identity for signature.version, the valid pre-release manifest's signed for its own tag, refused signed pairs each naming the step that refuses it (refused_by: signature, manifest or version), and a signed checksums.txt with the scaffold tarball it names, which the scaffold package's tests serve. manifest_test.go verifies them with VerifyManifest and VerifyBlob; `go test ./internal/release -run TestRegenerateFixture -regenerate` (from apps/codex) rewrites the signature section under a new instance and keeps the rest. Verification reads the signed timestamps, never the clock, so the section stays valid. A real bundle of the public-good instance is recorded beside these after the first tagged release that signs release.json. selection is the one rule for the release an install or an update takes when no version is named, as the GitHub releases API lists them (draft, prerelease, tag_name), read page by page (per_page=100, from page 1 until a page holds fewer than 100 releases, at most 10 pages; each row's pages are those answers, any later page empty; a tenth page that is full means the listing cannot be read whole, which refuses, a row marked incomplete): the newest release that is not a pre-release (not marked one by GitHub and without a pre-release in its tag) and, while none is listed, the newest pre-release, by SemVer precedence; drafts and tags outside the release-version grammar are skipped, and picks null is a listing with none to take. scripts/install.sh (tests/install-verify-test.sh), release.Latest (apps/codex/internal/release/release_test.go) and Cyfr.ReleaseChannel's newest/1 (apps/cyfr/test/cyfr/release_channel_test.exs) hold it.
